answer: Use escrowed, rotating task passes. 1) Each new key locks 54 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 54,000 POA, risks 27,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. This month-long lock makes replication costly. Like a voyage across an ocean, a relic has one verifiable origin, not a fleet of aliases.
